description: Estimate adding properties. What adding a number of properties to the campaign would cost: the charge due today, the amount charged later as later pieces go out, and whether your wallet or auto-reload covers it. Nothing is added or charged. The count is an upper bound; properties skipped when you add them are not charged. For a paused campaign the charge due today is 0 and charged_on_resume is true: each piece is charged as it goes out after the campaign resumes. Retrieves data without changing records or spending credits.

count.description: How many properties you plan to add, a whole number from 1 to 5000

name: dealmachine_get_mail_campaigns_id_properties_estimate
